facts.fact: Starlink is on sale in Kenya, with a capped plan priced at $10 a month in 2026 (about 5.5% of monthly GNI per capita); date is the article date as it gives none.

Amazon Kuiper Kenya Limited has applied for a 15-year International Gateway Operator licence, after an earlier application for a Network Facilities Provider licence; no Amazon licence is stated as granted.

Starlink temporarily stopped accepting new residential orders in several Kenyan counties in 2026 after available capacity was exhausted (capacity limit, not a regulatory ban); undated within 2026, article date used.
